# Cheinly

> Escrow-protected marketplace for buyers and sellers in Nigeria, with verified delivery through logistics partners.

## Pages

- [Home](/): What Cheinly is and how escrow-protected transactions work.
- [Browse](/buyer/browse): Public product and seller browsing.
- [Buy](/buy): Start a protected purchase.
- [Help Centre](/help): Guides on orders, refunds, disputes and package pickup.
- [Contact Support](/help/contact): Reach the Cheinly support team.

## Optional

- [Sign in](/auth/login): Existing account sign-in.
- [Create account](/auth/signup): Buyer or seller signup.
